Mailto Link Generator

Generate a properly encoded mailto: link with to, cc, bcc, subject and body — click to test, copy to use in any website or email signature.

Open in email app

Tip: paste the copied link into any <a href="..."> on your site.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the recipient addresses, subject and message body.
  2. The encoded mailto: link is generated live below.
  3. Click the link to test it in your email app, or copy it for your website.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do mailto links work?

mailto: links open the visitor's default email app with the recipient, subject and body pre-filled. Everything after the ? must be percent-encoded, which this tool does for you.

Can I add multiple recipients?

Separate multiple addresses with commas. Both comma and semicolon separators you type are normalized to commas.

Does the message body keep line breaks?

Yes — the body is encoded with encodeURIComponent, so newlines, quotes and special characters survive intact.

Is my email content private?

Absolutely, everything runs in your browser and nothing is sent anywhere.
